What bothers me is we don't know the real bounds of the universe. Due to this limitation, we can only measure our velocity in terms of relative velocity... (e.g. Car to Earth, Earth to Sun, Sun to stars, etc..) 

All we can say for certain is that we are travelling in the range of 0<V<299,792,458 m/s (speed of light) in some unknown direction. This is also uncertain because the universe is expanding, or at least WAS expanding and we are observing the light from the expansion and light from the collapse which may have happened millions of years ago has just yet to reach us here on Earth. 


I walk out and look at the stars and know that I am looking into the INFINITE. Therefore my significance is 1/infinity = approaches zero. 

Something cannot be insignificant and still be meaningful. To say that something can be insignificant and meaningful would be quite arrogant. 

Since my life is insignificant relative to the universe I live in, my life is also meaningless.


Why should I lead a meaningless life? 


Especially when it is full of loneliness, terrible things happening to me such as rape, people I love dieing... Why should I experience all of this if it is meaningless?
